freeze_statement: Reference data, mapping, simulated conditions and acceptance criteria were fixed before any simulated yield ratio for these stages and intensities was produced or inspected. Earlier damage-matrix diagnostics (V3/V8/V12 at 25/75%, seed 123456) were not consulted when setting the tolerance. Nothing in this file may change after the first comparison run; a change requires a new dated file and the old result stays on record.

reference.publication: Crop Protection Network CPN-4016, An Overview of Hail Injury and Fungicide Use on Corn, Table 2
reference.underlying_source: Applied Research for Corn Production in Indiana, https://docs.lib.purdue.edu/purduepress_ebooks/96/
reference.aggregation: treatment means combined across two years (2024, 2025) and three hybrids in Indiana
reference.reported_statistics: letters within stage at P<0.1 only; no SE, LSD or replicate data on the page
not_stated_in_source_page: defoliation tool and whether percent means leaf area or leaf number
reference.calibration_independence: 2024-2025 observations first published in 2026; they cannot have entered the coefficients of the DSSAT 4.8 cultivar used by the MARS environment.

mapping_assumptions.intensity: nominal defoliation percent / 100 applied once as the uniform leaf dry-mass and green-area removal fraction (0.33, 0.66, 0.99)
mapping_assumptions.V8: first decision day on or after planting with native vstage >= 8
mapping_assumptions.V13: first decision day on or after planting with native vstage >= 13
mapping_assumptions.R1: first decision day with native istage == 4 (CERES silking reached)
mapping_assumptions.known_mismatch: CERES vstage counts leaf tips while field V stages count collars, so the simulated pulse can precede the field stage by about two leaves. This is not adjusted.
mapping_assumptions.no_remapping_rule: If a stage is not reached in a season, that run is invalid and the tier fails closed. Stages and fractions are not remapped after results are seen.

simulation.backend: LeafDiagnosticBackend, UFGA8201 MARS environment inputs, experimental native leaf writer
simulation.management: scheduled 10 mm irrigation at DAP 10,20,...,80 (80 mm) and nitrogen 27/35/54 kg N/ha at DAP 40/45/80 (116 kg N/ha), unchanged from scripts/diagnose_damage_matrix.py water=1 nitrogen=1
simulation.seed_note: validation range 1-4999; chosen before any run; never the test range
simulation.statistic: per cell: mean over seasons of (damaged yield / same-season undamaged control yield); seasons with zero control yield invalidate the tier
simulation.condition_caveat: The Indiana trials yielded about 258 bu/ac under non-limiting conditions; the MARS management regime on UFGA sand may carry water or nitrogen stress. Control-season stress is reported with the result and is not used to select conditions.

criteria.tolerance_basis: The source reports no SE. Within-stage letters at P<0.1 separate yields 28.3 bu/ac apart (0.110 of the check) and do not separate yields 10.9 bu/ac apart (0.042), so the trial resolves ratio differences somewhere in (0.042, 0.110]. 0.10 lies at the lenient end of that interval and equals the conventional ten percentage points.

gating.timing_order_at_99pct: simulated mean ratio strictly decreases V8 > V13 > R1, as observed

reported_not_gating: per-cell error and cells with absolute error above tolerance
across-season standard deviation of each ratio
control yield and stress by season
criteria.pass_rule: both gating criteria hold with all 160 runs valid

scope_if_passed: single defoliation events between V8 and R1 at 33-99% leaf removal under the fixed management regime. Repeated damage, damage under imposed water or nitrogen deficit, and stages outside V8-R1 remain unverified. Cells with absolute error above tolerance are listed as outside the verified range even if the tier passes.

excluded_sources.rahman2022: lower-leaf stripping below 60 cm or below the cob leaf cannot be mapped to uniform removal; kept as descriptive evidence only
excluded_sources.battaglia_2012_2013: treatment yields are not stored locally and V7 100% also cuts the leaf-sheath stem; kept as descriptive evidence only
excluded_sources.fcic_early_hail_chart: V5-V9 losses of 0-9% up to 60% defoliation (2025 USDA FCIC handbook p. 86, as reproduced in CPN-4016 Table 1); context only, not an experiment
